title: Data architecture through rollout
text: At HG Insights, Prateek designed a geo-standardization service for 15M+ US and Canada company records and carried the work through a phased rollout with stakeholders.
limitation: Career account. Employer data and implementation are not public.

title: PostgreSQL at scale
text: At HG Insights, Prateek scaled PostgreSQL beyond 30M rows using partitioning, composite indexing and read replicas, reducing dashboard latency by more than 60%.
limitation: Career account. This result belongs to the HG Insights system, not a personal AI project.

title: Recovery as part of system design
text: At Cognizant, working for client Capital One, Prateek worked on Kafka workflows using dead-letter queues, bounded retry with backoff and idempotent replay.
limitation: Career account. Idempotent replay is not a universal exactly-once delivery guarantee.

title: Manufacturing workflow automation
text: At Agilent, Prateek built internal Gemba reporting and action-tracking applications using Power Apps and Power Automate. Gemba walks are Lean shop-floor observation rounds. Both apps are used by colleagues, reducing manual coordination. Global manufacturing and technology leadership expressed interest in broader plant rollout.
limitation: This is internal workflow automation. Broader rollout is an expressed interest, not a completed deployment. No quantified savings, adoption count or externally shipped AI product is claimed. Employer implementation details remain private.

title: Research orchestration
text: Assay originated in the SuperDataScience CP044 community project. Prateek contributed to analyst fan-out, bull, bear, risk and reporter stages in Python and LangGraph, with reports streamed through FastAPI server-sent events.
limitation: Contribution to a community project. Pinned source review, not a reproduced live-model run or sole-authorship claim.

title: Comparing agent workflows
text: Assay includes an evaluation harness comparing debate and non-debate workflows. It records judge preferences, token usage and estimated cost. Structured output validates shape, not factual accuracy. No reproduced model-quality result is claimed.
limitation: Fixed judge order, excluded failed pairs and node-summed latency limit interpretation of the harness.

title: Application engineering around inference
text: ChatFormula1 v2 contains a stateless routed Python/LangGraph retrieval pipeline, a developing Elixir/Phoenix gateway and a React streaming client. The client reducer handles duplicate and replayed events. Public v1 is separate from this reviewed v2 source.
limitation: Current deployment and model quality are unverified. The browser mechanism uses synthetic events, not a live project run.
